    resource: aws.ec2
    filters:
      - State.Name: running
      - type: value
        key: Placement.AvailabilityZone
        op: not-in
        value: [eu-central-1a, eu-central-1b, eu-central-1c]

meta.english: Everything must stay in eu-central-1
